evidence.observation: Pressure 2.90 Torr at start of growth, flat near 2.93-2.96 throughout the ramp
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.224 Torr, about 0.06-0.08 Torr per event
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the flow did not cause the pressure rise
Thermocouple at 750.2 °C with stable heater power, so temperature control looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; the growth atmosphere cannot be checked

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 reading, or a leak-up or rate-of-rise test with the pump isolated, to tell air ingress (seal leak) apart from a restricted exhaust (blockage); also the normal-run pressure reference.
